entries.test: Alphabet's February 8, 2023 market-capitalization change and contemporaneous market reporting would establish whether the chatbot error caused an approximately $100 billion loss in market value.
entries.note: The plain reading is a loss of market capitalization, not a cash expenditure.

entries.test: Demo recordings, release dates, product-access restrictions, documented errors, and contemporaneous coverage would establish the prototypes' similarities, readiness, timing, and contrasting reception.
entries.note: The surrounding text identifies Microsoft as receiving the revolutionary reception and Google the disastrous one.

entries.test: Public evaluations demonstrating that chatbots reliably avoid hallucinations across representative real-world uses would establish that the problems have been ironed out.
entries.note: The eventual resolution is a firm expectation; 'possibly' qualifies the route through fresh discoveries. No deadline is given.
